additional_requirements.title: Test defining of all build steps as code
additional_requirements.text: Verify that all build steps are defined as code and stored in a version control system.

additional_requirements.title: Test clearly defined build stage input and output for steps
additional_requirements.text: For each build stage, verify that the expected input and output are clearly defined.

additional_requirements.title: Test writing of output to a separate, secured storage repository
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline that produces output artifacts, ensure that they're written to a secured storage repository.

additional_requirements.title: Test tracking and reviewing of changes to pipeline files
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline file, ensure changes to it are being tracked and reviewed.

additional_requirements.title: Test minimizing access to build process triggering
additional_requirements.text: For every pipeline in use, verify only the necessary users have permission to trigger it.

additional_requirements.title: Test automatic scanning of pipelines for misconfigurations
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, verify that it is automatically scanned for misconfigurations.

additional_requirements.title: Test automatic scanning of pipelines for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, verify that it is automatically scanned for vulnerabilities.

additional_requirements.title: Test presence of scanners to identify and prevent sensitive data in pipeline files
additional_requirements.text: For every pipeline that is in use, verify that scanners are set to identify and prevent the existence of sensitive data within it.
